---
title: "Diffusionless Lorenz System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y-x \\
\dot{y} &=& -xz \\
\dot{z} &=& xy-a
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=1$ and initial condition $(1,0,1)$.
